'''Seleisin''' is a place that is thought to be extremely isolated. Elayne thinks that perhaps there might be a crofter in Seleisin that does not know of the Tower split, but that would be all{{ref/book|9|9}}. Moiraine knows no more about how soon Tarmon Gai'don will happen than does a redbird in Seleisin does{{ref/book|5|7}}.
